text: Surprisingly, the whole time I’ve been at Olympus U, I’ve never visited the campus pool…
There was a local pool back home, but it was much more casual and not an actual lap pool like this… It’s kind of impressive.
Where is everybody though? I thought Jacques said the swim team had its practice right now…?
D-Did I take too long getting over here? Maybe they’re already done…
Aww, what a bummer… I was really looking forward to seeing those cute, half-naked guys and their tight, swimmer bodies…
Hmmm, what should I do now…?
I guess since I’m looking for the student council president, I should head over to their office…?
Wait a second, what’s that…?
Whoa, someone’s diving in…! As I caught a glimpse of the swimmer, time seemed to slow down as I admired his form...
Just like I'd hoped, he was almost naked, and I could instantly see how well-toned his body was... Not only that, but his perky butt was perfectly visible from this angle!
Has he been here the whole time?! How did I not notice him?
What are you doing here?
Oh my god, this is the view I’ve been wanting…! A full frontal of a nearly-naked, fit swimmer right in front of my eyes…!
His tight, lean arms and slim waist are exactly what I’d expect from a swimmer, but I didn’t expect he’d be so pale considering his sport…!
The water dripping all over his skin makes me want to see him covered in something else…
And don’t even get me started on that bulge…! That speedo is doing basically nothing to hide it, so I can already see the firm outline of his—
If you're here to swim I'm afraid you've got the wrong cloths on.
A-Ack! I’m sorry, I was, uh…
The pool’s off-limits to non-members during practice hours. And you shouldn’t be standing so close with those shoes on, the tiles are wet.
Uh.. I was actually just on my way to the uh.. to the changing rooms.
If you say so. Anyway, I need to resume my laps.
I just have to dive in I guess.
Wow the water is just perfect. I see why they would practice here.
Oh and there's Avan. I better catch up with him.
Look at that speed…! He’s like a fish, moving so quickly through the water!
There's no way I'm catching up to him. I might as well wait for him to finish the lap and come back.
Whaa, it's been a long day...
I'd really need a good night of rest...
This is button 1
This is button 2
This is button 3
This is button 4
This is button 5
This is button 6
button 1
button 2
button 3
button 4
button 5
button 6
Actually, I'll just head to the dorm and call it a day...
Let me get into eepy sleepy mode!
Muuuch better! Finally getting a break...
After all that...
Action...
Let's have some weeeeell deserved fun hehe~
Muuuch better! Finally getting a break...
After all that...
Action...
I need to change my clothes first...
The exterior of the dorm is so peaceful...
Oh! Leo is there! Should I go talk to him?
Hey Leo! What's up?
Hey Ace! I was heading to my room!
I'm so tired... I've been studying all day...
H-Hnnnn… Wh-Wha…?
Aww, you gotta be kidding me… that dream again?
It always stops right there too…
*sigh*
Every day is like this… the same dream, over and over about things I don’t have, and things that have never even happened to me… at least not yet.
College life has been empty so far, and everyone says it’s supposed to be this big, exciting time of my life.
There’s all this pressure to “make something out of myself” but how am I supposed to know what that thing is?
I’ve never really known what I want, even though everyone else seems to... It makes me feel like I’m lagging behind.
Ugh… Not like I’m doing anything to make it better, either. Days keep going by and it’s the same old, same old.
What’s the point in thinking about this, anyway?
Ugh… Nothing a good fap can’t fix. Let’s see where I left off last night…
Oh right, this one was a knock-off from that game. Not really into the characters though…
Lemme look for something else… The new anime I saw yesterday had a hot guy in it.
Wow, somebody already made porn of him. That didn’t take long.
Eh, still not feeling it though… Let’s just go with the easy win.
Nothing beats the real thing… Sporty guys always do it for me…
Something about fit bodies in uniforms really gets me going…
Hnn… All that sweat and muscle… So hot...
Hahh…
Hey, Ace! Good morning!
How about waiting for an invitation first, Matt?!
Hey, I knocked this time AND waited a few seconds!
I've run into you doing your business already way too many times since middle school.
Wait… Your hand’s in your pants again… Don’t tell me—
*sigh* I always forget to lock my door…
Ugh, after all these years I shouldn’t be surprised.
Anyway, what the heck are you still doing in bed at 9:00 AM?
Uhh… I kinda stayed up too late last night binging that new anime that just came out.
Right… “Anime”. Definitely not just a bunch of dudes banging.
H-Hey, I don’t judge what’s in your stash!
We’re getting off topic – why aren’t you at class now?!
W-Well… I don’t have any yet.
Huh? How come?
I kinda reduced my class load for this semester…
Wait…! Why?
I was so tired last semester! Between projects, classes, and exams going on all at once – it was too much for me! I just wanted to take it easy this time…
So, are you only taking classes for your major? You don’t wanna fall behind on your core subjects, you know…
A-Actually, about that… I haven’t really decided on one yet…
What?! You still haven’t picked a major? But you told me you would figure it out during winter break!
I knowwww… it’s just, nothing is really clicking with me yet…
Ace… It’s already the second semester… You need to at least have an idea of what you want to do before it’s too late.
Ever since I’ve known you, you always put things off till the last minute.
But that’s not gonna work here in college, man. Do you really wanna be in this loop forever?
But hey, lighten up! Your best friend’s here to save the day! I actually barged in here ’cause I have something for you!
On my way out of track club this morning, I passed by a bulletin board and found this!
And this is…?
It’s a survey for people like you who can’t decide on what club they wanna join.
I assumed you didn’t have one, and since you haven’t picked a major yet either, you should at least find something to be a part of!
I guess that’s fair… But I’m not sure I really wanted to even be a part of a club…
Well, you’ll never know unless you try! I know it’s tough for you making big decisions, so I thought maybe something like this would help!
It’s mostly general questions too, so if you answer honestly and submit this to the student association, they’ll recommend some clubs that fit your personality!
And once you find a group you can vibe with, maybe they can give you ideas to figure out what you want.
*sigh* Do I really have to…?
Yes, you do! You don’t have anything to lose, right?
…Okay, I’ll think about it…
Don’t think about it, just do it!
And even after you do it, if it doesn’t work out, you can move on to something else.
Just give it a shot and see if you like what you get!
This is your chance to find something that suits you and change your life for the better! Trust me!
Th-Thanks, Matt. I promise I’ll at least try it…
Alright, I’ll take your word for it, then! Let me know how it turns out when we hang out later tonight, too!
And tell you what, if you manage to fill it out AND submit it to the council, pizza’s on me – you can even pick the toppings!
Oh man, that's a low blow... You know I can't say no to an offer like that.
If that’s what it takes to get you back on track, it’s worth it!
Alright. No takebacks.
Same goes for you! Anyway, I should probably head to my class!
Oh right, my class starts in an hour so I should start getting ready now too.
Get your lazy ass out of bed then – and don’t forget to shower too!
Ahehe… Right… Thanks again, Matt!
See ya later, Ace!
After I got out of bed and hopped into the shower, I started thinking about what Matt said...
Maybe he's right; it's time for a change. I need to start making the most of my college life…
Olympus University… An all-boys campus with the best athletic programs in the country.
Pretty much every sport you can think of is here and each one is a marvel in their own right... All the teams are constantly winning tournaments and taking home trophies.
When you're on campus, you're constantly surrounded by athletes in peak form… as if they were sculpted by the gods themselves.
Honestly, they're what drew me to sports in the first place, not the games themselves.
I’m not particularly athletic and I’ve always been average at best at any sport I’ve tried…
I know, I know… It doesn’t make sense that a normal guy like me is here in the first place.
I honestly couldn’t pick which college to go to after high school, and only applied for Olympus when I found out Matt chose to go here.
I dunno how I even got accepted, since my grades are pretty average... Guess it must've been a stroke of luck. Or maybe fate...
*gasp* Enough day dreaming, that’s my cue to head to class!
*sigh* What’s even the point of this literature class... it already seems so boring…
Core classes like these don't feel like they're any help figuring out what I want to do...
It's been like this since last semester, random classes with random people I don't know, so I can't even make any new friends.
It’s starting to get frustrating how I can’t ever make up my mind about anything…
My struggle to make any kind of decision is following me everywhere... I don’t have a major, I don’t have a social circle, I don’t have a club—
Wait a minute… How about that pamphlet Matt gave me this morning…?
*goes through his backpack*
I guess I could look at this… It’s not like there’s anything going on in this class anyway.
W-Wow… there sure are a lot of options…
Right off the bat, they’re showing off the campus’ most popular sports clubs – basketball, volleyball, soccer, swimming, football, wrestling, and more…
Hehe… I could join just to watch the guys play; I’d be happy to do that…
I can't see myself actually playing any of these, though. I'd be useless…
It looks like there's a bunch of non-sports options too, but there's like a hundred of them! How am I supposed to choose?!
I mean… this’ll be what I spend most of my time at school doing!
*sigh* This is why it’s so hard to make a decision…
Oh, wait. There’s more on the back…
Huh…? “Fill out this form and find the perfect club!”
Oh right! This is what Matt was telling me about. I guess I did say I’d fill it out, so might as well give it a shot.
Is that really it?
How exactly are these questions related to any of the clubs?
Wh-What?! Class is over already?!
I guess it took me longer to answer these than I thought...
The pamphlet says to drop the form off at the student center and they'll email me their results... Maybe I should go and do that?
It makes me kinda nervous though... I really can't see how they'll make a decision based on any of that.
What if I answered wrong? And even if they pick something out for me, what if I don’t end up joining after all?
I don’t wanna waste anyone in the council’s time…
*sigh* Here I go again, overthinking it…
Matt's right; I've got nothing to lose. Besides, I've already done the hard part, so I may as well submit it and get my pizza!
Let’s see… The drop box should be around here somewhere…
Ah, there it is…!
*sigh* Do I really wanna do this…? I know I just have to submit this form but… why do I feel like something’s holding me back…
Hey, you there!!
H-huh…?
Yeah, you! The boy with the denim jacket!
I see you holding that form. Are you looking for a club perhaps?
Y-Yeah, I was just about to submit it…
You seem unsure. Having second thoughts?
Honestly… Y-Yeah…
Well, well, well, the sisters of fate are definitely on my side today!
Why don’t you join my club instead?
Y-Your club?
Yes! The wonderful and exciting Film Club, founded by yours truly, Jacques Laurent! I didn’t get your name yet though!
Ah, it’s Ace. Ace Anderson.
Perfect! I’ll get you registered right away!
Wait, wait, wait! I’m not sure I want to join.
Ah-ah, don’t say no just yet! You won’t get another offer like this, like EVER! It’s pretty EXCLUSIVE, just so you know~
E-Exclusive? Is that why your club wasn’t on this form?
Well, we’re pretty new to the scene, plus I prefer to handpick my members!
Wh-Why me then?
Call it intuition! You've got the right “fit” and you look like you’d be into this, like a LOT! I’m getting major vibes from you for some reason!
I… think you got the wrong guy. I don’t know much about film…
Between you and me… It’s not your typical ‘film’ club~
It’s the kind that gets your blood flowing, if you know what I mean~
Like action-packed ones, right…?
Yeah, I’m sure a guy like you has seen one or two!
I have, but I’m not sure how I’ll be of any help.
We’re amateur so it’ll be mostly fun and not complicated at all!
The good thing too is that you don’t need experience going into it – in fact, the fresher you are, the better!
I-Is that how it works?
I guarantee when you join, all your wildest fantasies will come true!
Eh?
Hehe, curious now? How about you come with me, and I’ll give you a quick tour of the club?
I, uhh…
Oh crap, what should I do? An opportunity is being handed to me on a silver platter but I still can’t decide!
Nothing else has clicked today, or any days before that. Am I really just gonna let this chance go by too?
Look, I know it’s a lot to process, and you don’t have to say yes right away. You can decide once you see it!
How long will I let myself keep acting like this?
Why am I always stopping myself short? What am I even afraid of?
Uh… Ace?
Snap out of it, Ace! You’ll never find your purpose if you don’t bother to make an effort!
Ahh… I guess you need to go to your next class now, huh?
Actually… I’ll go with you.
Splendid! I knew you passed my vibe check!
You won’t regret it! Follow me, and I’ll show you the place!
Alright, we made it!
I-Is this really the place? I thought most of the clubs met near the campus center…
They do! But I pulled a few strings and got us access to this building!
Not only that, but since our club is so ‘exclusive,’ we have the whole place to ourselves! Isn’t it great?
I-I guess that’s nice, it does seem really private.
I know, right? It’s perfect for our activities!
We don’t want any surprise interruptions after all, right~?
Uhh…
Well, come on! No point standing around outside!
I’ll show you around!
Welcome to the Film Club!
Oh… Uh… W-Wow.
Hehe, like the place?
A-Ah, I didn’t expect it to be so… uhh… rustic…?
Yeah, it is a little rough, but I’ve been doing my best to get it cleaned up! I just got this place at the start of the semester, you know.
R-Right, that makes sense…
It looks a bit empty. Where’s everyone else?
Oh, it’s just me and one other member, but I believe he’s busy with practice right now.
Ah, I-I see…
So, about the tour, I know the place isn't much right now, but just think of the possibilities – the whole building to ourselves!
We already have this wonderful lobby to hang out in, and a separate room for club activities!
Not only that, but there are tons of facilities in here that just need a little work and funding; then they'll be ready for our use! Can't you see the potential?
That does sound promising…
Right? I was lucky to get my hands on this place. It was a hassle, let me tell you!
You’re really passionate about this, huh?
Of course! I’m a film major, after all! So, a project like this is right up my alley!
What about you? I never got the chance to ask what you’re studying.
A-Ahh, well… I’m only taking core classes… for now…
Oh... No wonder you’re available this time of day! Are you still struggling to settle on a major?
Y-Yeah, guilty as charged…
You’re not a very decisive person, are you Ace?
*sigh* I guess anyone can tell…
I kinda had the feeling when I first invited you here, you looked like you were in your head a lot.
But don’t despair! It’s common for us students to be unsure about our futures. It takes a while for everyone to figure out what they want in life!
I know because I was in the same boat as you for quite a while.
R-Really? How were you able to get over it? And you know, decide on something?
Sometimes we end up overthinking things that shouldn’t be so complicated, especially when you look at the grand scheme of things!
I don’t think there needs to be a huge sense of purpose in everything we do, as long as we’re having fun and living life, shouldn’t that be enough?
O-Oh… I guess I never thought of it that way…
I know we seem like a relatively small and run down club, and I can’t blame you if that influences your decision to join.
But my goal for this year is to make it into a big circle that loves to have “fun”!
I know it doesn’t sound serious, and it shouldn’t be! I just want to make the most of it, even better if it’s with others!
I’ve already committed myself, so I might as well go all the way, right?
Nothing ever changes unless we do something about it, after all. To me, it’s much better to regret a choice later than regret doing nothing at all!
I’ve always spent so much time worrying about making the right decision that I never took the chance to try anything.
Maybe it is better to jump into something and see where it takes me?
…Alright then, I’m joining the club.
Wha—?
I want to be part of something, and like you said, I’ll never know what I’m missing out on if I don’t try.
And if you think there’s something I can do to help you reach your goal, then I want to help!
Yaayyy! That’s wonderful! Welcome to the club, Ace!
I’m sure it won’t let you down! This is the start of something great, I tell you!
I hope so, Jacques… I’m just glad I decided on something for once.
I knew I was right to approach you back there!
So… Uhh… When do I start?
Oh, wow! Guess I can’t blame you for being excited about this! I’d be too!
Lucky for you I have the first club activity scheduled for today!
Oh, great! What do you need me to do?
If you recall, I mentioned there was another member of the club that I recruited recently!
So, for your first task, I’ll need you to go and fetch him for me, then I can give you both the detailed orientation at the same time. Less repeating of myself, you see?
That makes sense, sure! Who am I looking for?
His name is Julio Mendez. He’s from the soccer team and is a bundle of sunshine!
He should be at the soccer field at his after-class practice now. Tell him I sent you to pick him up!
I’ve got a bit more tidying to do around here, so by the time you two get back things should be ready for us to get started!
Alright, I’ll be back in a bit!
Au revoir!
As I made my way to the soccer field, I was struck with how surreal it was that *I* was part of a club now.

Although to be honest, I’m still not entirely sure WHAT we’re supposed to be doing just yet, but it seems interesting so far. And considering how eccentric the club leader is, I’m really curious about the other member.
For once, I’m making a change, and maybe it won’t be so bad!
The whole time I’ve been at Olympus U, I’ve never visited the soccer field…
My high school had one I would pass by regularly, but it wasn’t anywhere near as big as this one. And it’s still only the practice field!
Man, this campus really is extra when it comes to sports.
Ok, before I get distracted… I need to look for Julio Mendez… I totally forgot to ask Jacques what he looks like…
The only thing he said was that this guy is a real character… But that could be any of these guys.
Hmm… It’s not really worth backtracking to the club, so I guess I’ll just ask around.
Oh, it looks like they’re in the middle of a practice game…
Maybe watching for a little while wouldn’t hurt… I’ve never been this close to an actual soccer game, after all!
I can see the players sprinting across the field from here…
How do they manage to move so fast and still focus on the ball…?
Speaking of fast, looks like one of them is still pulling ahead of the others!
Whoa… even though this guy is small, he’s bursting with energy… and it’s clear he knows his way around the ball…
I wonder if players like him have the same stamina in bed… If you can run that much, you must be able to go for multiple rounds in a row…
Oh crap, did he sense me staring?!
You’re almost there!! Go for the goal, Leo!
Got it!
Ohhhhh!
Taking the cue from his teammates, the blond guy went for a powerful kick, sending the ball straight for the goal.
It seemed like everything slowed down for just a moment, and as his shirt fluttered in the breeze, it gave me a peek of his lean stomach… and my eyes traveled down to his lean, muscled thighs…
I raised my head to see a quickly moving object zooming straight in my direction, cutting my thoughts short with a-
Oh shit, is he dead?!
You got him good, Leo! That was a clean headshot!
Gaaah! I didn’t mean to!
We’re lucky the coach isn’t here. Quick, hide the body!
This isn’t a joke, you guys, he’s totally out cold!
Should we call an ambulance?
Nnngh…
Wait, wait, I hear him groaning…!
Man, I still can’t get over that kick, Leo. It would’ve been an easy goal if this guy wasn’t calling your shots!
Sorry, I got carried away! Can’t help but get excited whenever I see Leo’s plays.
Right? His instincts are topnotch! We definitely have a chance at the championship with Leo around!
Come on, you guys! We need to bring this guy back to life! Should I give him CPR?
Am I dreaming…? There’s a strange, bright light shining down on me…
Wait, don’t tell me I’m actually dead?!
This must’ve been the lamest life filled with nothing but porn and anime, and now I’m dying in the most undignified of ways.
But if so… heaven’s not so bad – the myths were true; I’m already being greeted by a beautiful, blond angel.
Hey, snap out of it, dude!
Oh, thank goodness, you’re awake!
H-Huh…?
I’m so, so, sorry! I didn’t think the ball would ricochet like that!
I’m alive?
Ah… Hehe, yes. Welcome back, dude.
Looks like everything’s good here, let’s get back to practice!
I’ll catch up, you guys! I need to make sure this guy’s okay!
Alright, Leo! You can sit out the rest of this one!
Thanks, guys! I’ll make up for it next time!
Wow, this guy's even cuter up close... Staring down at me with those big, fiery, eyes and his blond, poofy hair that glows like the sun.
Not to mention those cheeks, they're so cute and round when he smiles! I just want to pinch them!
Hey, sorry about that again. You’re not hurt, are you?
I think I’m fine…
More than fine actually, can I just stay here on the ground and bask in his radiance?
Lemme help you up!
A-Ah, it’s alright…! I got it!
*sigh* All good things must come to an end…
I know this is probably like the third time, but I’m super sorry about that! I’m usually not that bad, I swear!
I-It’s alright… It was just an accident. And it’s kinda on me for standing so close to the field like that…
I’m Leo, by the way! I don’t think I’ve seen you here before!
W-Well, I—
Wait! Don’t tell me… are you here for tryouts?! We need some new players!
A-Actually, no, I’m here looking for someone. Do you happen to know a Julio Mendez?
BLECH! Don’t say that name out loud! Only my mom calls me that!
Oh! So, you’re Juli— I mean, Leo!
Yep, that’s me, Leo Mendez! And you are?
I’m Ace Anderson…! And I think I’m here to pick you up…?
Pick me up? Weren’t you the one on the ground a minute ago? Haha!
Ah, no I mean… I’m from the film club and I was told to come get you for our first meeting!
Film clu— OH! Shit! I forgot about that…!
I would’ve totally missed it if it weren’t for you! Thanks for reminding me, Ace!
It’s okay! I’m only following orders. I just joined the club actually.
Oooh, me too! I actually just found out about the film club a week ago! That film-major guy invited me to join, and he really sold on me the whole idea!
I mean, how could I say no? It’s something new, plus it sounds like it’s gonna be lots of fun!
Ah… yeah. I guess that’s why I joined too.
Wait, so does that mean… you’re a part of two clubs?
Three, actually! Some of my buddies joined a roleplaying game club and I didn’t wanna miss out!
On top of your classes? Isn’t that a bit much?
Nah! Two of them aren’t sports, so they’re easier to handle! Besides, the film club seemed like it’s a one-of-a-kind chance that I couldn’t pass up!
Wow... I’m really impressed you’re in so many groups. It took me long a time to join even a single club.
Hehe, thanks. I just wanna make the most of my college life y’know?
I’m still a freshman but as they say, “there’s no time like the present”!
Ah… I’m a freshman too, but it already sounds like you’ve done so much more.
Well, you’re starting now and that’s what counts!
But we got carried away chatting! Lemme just go get changed and we can head to the club, alright?
Oh, right…! I’ll wait here for you!
Thanks! Be back in a jiffy!
Leo isn’t exactly what I was expecting from a film club member, but in a good way… He’s super energetic and friendly.
Not only that, but he's involved in so many things already... He’s like the exact opposite of me.
Maybe it'll be good to hang out with someone like him... I might learn a few of his habits!
But if we’re talking about the real win here... Not only is Leo easy to talk to, but he’s also really cute and handsome.
Being into guys and all, sometimes I get flustered and it’s so hard to have these kinds of interactions, but with him it just came so naturally.
What a first impression… I just hope the next time I get hit in the face by him it's with a different ball...
Hey, sorry about that! I’m ready to go now!
Holy crap! He got even cuter!
And… are those tan lines on his shoulders?! What I wouldn’t give to have been in that locker room!
His shorts are so loose too! Maybe I should pass out again and accidentally grab them on the way down?
Dude, you alright? Are you still feeling light-headed from earlier?
Ah, yes! I mean, no! I’m alright!
Ready to go?
S-Sure…! Let’s head out!
Oh woooow! This place is a lot cleaner than it was last time I was here!
Yeah, Jacques said he was gonna tidy up while I was grabbing you.
Heya, Jackie!
Well, if it isn’t my lovely little ray of sunshine. Welcome back, Leo! And it’s Jacques, though I guess I don’t mind a pet name. How was practice?
It was great, as usual! You really amped the place up, huh?! It looks great!
Thanks! We’ve got a desk and a couch here in the lobby now, and the activity room is all set up too!
Anyway! Now that you’re both here, I can welcome you properly and give Ace a little briefing about our club!
Although we’re broadly called the film club, what sets us apart is the ‘style’ of movies we’ll be making!
W-Wait… we’re the ones making films?
Yes! We’ll offer a wide variety of categories, depending on what’s hot at the moment and what the people are dying to see!
They buy the films, and we get the cash to fund our club, which we then use to improve the facilities here and turn them into new filming locations!
And as an extra bonus, we all get to split any remaining profit!
Hold on, I’m confused… I thought we would just be watching movies together or something?
Well, we can watch what we make, but the real fun part is the acting!
But I’m not really much of an actor… and I never took any theater classes…
Not to worry, like I told you earlier, we’re only making amateur films! Every genuine emotion, sensation, and pleasure you show is for the better!
I-I dunno if I can pull that off though… I don’t wanna make things look awkward.
It’s quite alright! You can watch until you’re comfortable being on camera! And if that ends up not being your cup of tea, you can help some other way!
Take me for example – I’m no actor, but I do the video editing, sound tech, and all the other boring things involved in running the club!
I also do the scouting, recruiting, and role assignment!
Th-That all still sounds complicated… I’m not sure I’m cut out for that kind of work…
There’s a bunch of other fun stuff you can do too, Ace! You can help come up with themes and ideas for the films we make!
Yes, the bottom line is there’s many aspects of filming, so there’s sure to be something that can suit your interests!
